Search and Rescue Debrief

Gathers and summarizes findings from numerous team members after a search mission, matching up debrief notes across the team to produce one accurate, consolidated summary of what happened.

status
in development
section
projects
built with
Node.js, Express, SQLite
source code →

## overview

Each volunteer submits their own account of a mission through a structured questionnaire. Once every expected volunteer has submitted, the mission is ready for an AI-generated consensus debrief that reconciles where accounts agree and flags discrepancies for a mission lead to review.

## details

  • Built so far: the data model, a shared questionnaire schema, mission creation, and the volunteer submission flow with automatic status tracking.
  • Next: AI consensus generation with the Claude API.
